To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

projective integration methods can be extended from stiff ODEs to nonlinear collisional kinetic problems such as the BGKS and Boltzmann models, and the resulting telescopic projective methods can be made fully explicit.
we present high-order, explicit projective integration methods for nonlinear kinetic equations, and that the methods are essentially independent of the collision operator stiffness.

(i) Projective integration methods for the BGK and the Boltzmann equation are fully explicit and high order, (ii) the number of inner steps and the time step restriction of the outer method is independent of the collisional stiffness, (iii) the number of projective levels is independent of the spatial dimension, and (iv) the computational cost is independent of the number of projectives and of the stiffness.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and analysis of numerical methods for nonlinear kinetic equations.
the development of numerical methods for kinetic equations.
the design and analysis of high-order, explicit numerical integration methods for the nonlinear Boltzmann equation and related kinetic equations.

telescopic projective integrators are a viable and promising method for stiff kinetic equations.
the telescopic projective method is a very promising and effective approach to solve stiff problems.
the projective integration method is a powerful and flexible approach to solving nonlinear kinetic equations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed high-order, fully-explicit projective integration schemes with a computational cost independent of the stiffness, for a class of nonlinear kinetic equations.
we develop high order, fully explicit, projective integration schemes to solve stiff kinetic equations.
the method is fully implicit, fully explicit and fully stable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the projective integration approach provides a robust and efficient framework for solving stiff problems, with computational cost independent of the stiffness.
the projective integration method can be used as an effective, fully explicit integrator for stiff kinetic equations.

, in the case of nonlinear BGK and similar kinetic equations, the computational cost of a high-order, fully implicit scheme can be reduced by orders of magnitude by taking a few explicit steps at each outer time step.
